Best matches first, one result per record, each with its slug, title, the section the best match is in (its heading and anchor, to link to) and a highlighted snippet as plain and matching parts. Pass nextCursor back as cursor. Read-only.

operations.name: order.checkout
operations.description: Open the payment provider's own page to pay for an order, and get its address to send the buyer to. The host says what is charged: the whole price or the deposit for an order with nothing paid (no amount may be given), or, for a part-paid order, the balance or a part of it of at least the set minimum (`amount`, in the currency's minor unit). The buyer comes back to `returnUrl`, which must be on one of the deployment's listed sites; coming back does not mark anything paid. Only the provider's confirmation does. A guest passes the order's token; a signed-in customer pays their own orders.

token.description: A guest's token for the order

returnUrl.description: Where the buyer comes back to

amount.description: Part-paid orders only: how much to pay towards the balance, in minor units

operations.name: order.start
operations.description: Start an order for one or more records that are for sale, as a signed-in customer, a guest (with an email address) or staff. The host prices it from the records: a caller never sends a price or a total. The order starts pending and is not paid: paying happens on the payment provider's page (order.checkout), and only the provider's confirmation marks it paid. An unpaid order expires after a few minutes. Nobody buys without the agreements the business needs for what is bought: refused with rule agreements_due and the documents while any is due (a guest passes their acceptances in `agreements`; a signed-in customer agrees first; staff send a link, sign at the desk or record paper). Returns the order with its lines and amounts in the currency's minor unit; a guest also gets `token`, shown once, which is the only way back to the order (order.view).

lines.description: What to buy. There is no price here: the host reads it from each record, and a price or total sent anyway is ignored.

pay.description: full: pay the whole price now. deposit: pay the deposit now and the balance by its due date, when every line offers a deposit.

email.description: The buyer's email address. Required when the caller is not a signed-in customer; a signed-in customer's order uses their account's address and must not pass one.

A signed-in customer agrees first (me.agreements.accept); staff never agree for anyone.

operations.name: subscription.start
operations.description: Start a subscription to a plan (a record of an object sold every week, month or year), as a signed-in customer, a guest (with an email address) or staff for someone. Opens the payment provider's own page, which takes the card; the provider charges each period on its own schedule, after the plan's free trial when it has one. A trial is one per person per plan, and only for a signed-in customer (or staff with subscriptions:manage starting it for a person): a guest is charged from the start, and `noTrial` says why no trial was given. Starting again while the page you opened with a trial is still open gives that page. A signed-in customer with a continuation offer (moving their subscription from another platform) takes it with `offerId`: free until their paid-up date, then charged, with no trial on top; with under 48 hours left it is charged at once. Nobody starts one without the agreements the business needs for the plan (its terms, a waiver): refused with rule agreements_due and the documents while any is due, a continuation offer included (a guest passes their acceptances in `agreements`; a signed-in customer agrees first; staff send a link or record paper). The host prices it from the plan: no price is sent. Coming back to `returnUrl` changes nothing: the subscription exists once the provider confirms it. Returns the page's address and what will be charged, in minor units.

returnUrl.description: Where the payer comes back to

email.description: The payer's email. Required unless the caller is a signed-in customer.

offerId.description: Take your continuation offer (subscription.offer.mine): free until its date, then charged. A signed-in customer's own offer only.

typedName.description: The name the person typed beside the box: personal data, never shown to an AI

signature.description: A drawn signature as strokes in a 1000 by 400 box: personal data

answers.description: A health form's answers: health information, never shown to an AI or logged

agreements.description: A visitor without an account only: what they agreed to on the way to paying, one entry per document the host says is due (each document's current version, the name they typed, a signature for a document agreed to by drawing, every answer for a health form). A signed-in customer agrees first (me.agreements.accept); staff never agree for anyone.

trialDays.description: The free days given; null: charged from the start

freeUntil.description: Free until this moment (a continuation offer taken), then charged; else null

noTrial.description: Why the plan's trial was not given: sign_in (a guest: only a signed-in customer gets a trial), used (one trial per person per plan, had already), permission (staff without subscriptions:manage), held (another page with the trial is open for this person), unconfirmed (the payment provider could not say whether an earlier page was completed; try again later for the trial), continuation (this person has an open continuation offer on this plan, or a subscription from one still running: no trial on top of it). Null otherwise

operations.name: x.bookings.buy
operations.description: Pay for one class (a drop-in), on the website: for a visitor, or a member with nothing to spend on it. The host makes the booking held while it is paid for (a place kept), prices it from the class's drop-in price, and starts its order; nothing is paid here. The buyer then calls order.checkout with the order's id (and a guest's token) to pay on the provider's page: the verified payment books them; an order left unpaid expires after a few minutes and the place goes back. The same rules as booking hold (when booking opens and closes, booked by the gym only, one booking per person per class); a full class is refused (only members with a membership or pass wait for a place). A signed-in member buys as themselves, or for a child the gym linked to them (forPersonId; they pay, it is the child's booking); a guest gives their email address. Cancelled in time, or by the gym, the money goes back to the card once a member of staff approves the refund; cancelled late, it is kept. Amounts in the currency's minor unit. (Extension tool from Bookings 0.1.0.)

forPersonId.description: A child of theirs to book for instead (a dependant the gym linked to them; see family). The child's own membership or pass pays, never the parent's.

agreements.description: A guest only: their acceptances of what is due, passed on to the host as they are (each { versionId, typedName, signature?, answers? }); the host checks and records them. A signed-in member agrees first.

expiresAt.description: When the held place goes back if unpaid

token.description: A guest's key to this order, shown once

reason.description: no_drop_in: the class cannot be paid for online (no drop-in price). ask_desk: the address given cannot be used. try_later: too many places are held for payment just now. waitlist_closed: the class is full and it is too close to the start to wait for a place (nobody is moved in from the waitlist then). not_open: booking has not opened yet (see opensAt). closed: booking has closed. not_running: the class was cancelled or is over. person_exists: someone on file has that email (see people). possible_duplicates: people on file may be this person (see people; book one of them, or ask again with confirmNew). staff_only: this class is booked by the gym. no_use: nothing the member holds can pay for it (see detail). already_booked: they already have a place. full: no places left. too_late: the class has started, so it cannot be cancelled. not_found: no such class or booking of theirs. changed: it changed meanwhile; try again.

people.description: For person_exists and possible_duplicates: who is already on file
